# DCYFR Research

> Deep dives into AI agent patterns, context engineering, delegation frameworks, and production-ready AI infrastructure from the DCYFR team.

## Pages
- [Home](https://dcyfr.tech/): Latest research articles and featured deep dives.
- [Articles](https://dcyfr.tech/articles): Full article archive.
- [Whitepapers](https://dcyfr.tech/whitepapers): Long-form research whitepapers.
- [Search](https://dcyfr.tech/search): Full-text search across all research content.

## Articles
- [Mobile Agent Approvals with Mosh + Tailscale](https://dcyfr.tech/articles/mosh-mobile-agent-approvals): How we replaced SSH-based mobile terminals with Mosh for lower reconnect rates and faster agent approval cycles from iOS.
- [Context Window Budget Management for Long-Running Agents](https://dcyfr.tech/articles/context-window-budget-management): Strategies for keeping agents within token limits across multi-turn conversations — including sliding windows, semantic compression, and budget guards.
- [The DCYFR Delegation Framework: Typed Agent Contracts at Scale](https://dcyfr.tech/articles/delegation-framework-deep-dive): How we built a type-safe delegation system that lets agents hand off work with confidence — covering contracts, error propagation, and approval gates.
